package domain

const (
	PracticeTaskAIReviewModeDisabled = "disabled"
	PracticeTaskAIReviewModeOptional = "optional"
	PracticeTaskAIReviewModeRequired = "required"

	PracticeTaskAIUnavailableMentorOnly = "mentor_only"
	PracticeTaskAIUnavailableBlock      = "block"

	PracticeTaskMentorReviewModeDisabled = "disabled"
	PracticeTaskMentorReviewModeRequired = "required"
)

type PracticeTaskReviewPolicy struct {
	Version      int                            `json:"version"`
	AIReview     PracticeTaskAIReviewPolicy     `json:"ai_review"`
	MentorReview PracticeTaskMentorReviewPolicy `json:"mentor_review"`
}

type PracticeTaskAIReviewPolicy struct {
	Mode          string `json:"mode"`
	OnUnavailable string `json:"on_unavailable"`
	MaxInputBytes int    `json:"max_input_bytes"`
}

type PracticeTaskMentorReviewPolicy struct {
	Mode string `json:"mode"`
}

type PracticeTaskAIReviewContract struct {
	Version            int      `json:"version"`
	TemplateCode       string   `json:"template_code"`
	ProviderCode       string   `json:"provider_code,omitempty"`
	LanguageCode       string   `json:"language_code"`
	ResponseSchemaCode string   `json:"response_schema_code"`
	RubricVersion      string   `json:"rubric_version"`
	WhatToCheck        []string `json:"what_to_check"`
	WhatNotToCheck     []string `json:"what_not_to_check"`
	AllowedVariations  []string `json:"allowed_variations"`
	UncertainWhen      []string `json:"uncertain_when"`
}

type PracticeTaskAIReviewResult struct {
	Decision string                         `json:"decision"`
	Summary  string                         `json:"summary"`
	Findings []PracticeTaskAIReviewFinding  `json:"findings"`
	Evidence []PracticeTaskAIReviewEvidence `json:"evidence"`
}

type PracticeTaskAIReviewFinding struct {
	Category string `json:"category"`
	Severity string `json:"severity"`
	Message  string `json:"message"`
	File     string `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Line     int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
}

type PracticeTaskAIReviewEvidence struct {
	Requirement string   `json:"requirement"`
	Observation string   `json:"observation"`
	Files       []string `json:"files"`
}
